retrievalProfile.description: A relaxed male portrait featuring a subject seated in an open-frame vehicle with a layered typographic lockup in the upper corner.
triggerTerms: man sitting in a roll cage vehicle
layered serif and sans-serif text overlay
excludeWhen: requesting high-contrast black and white photography

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man with dark hair sitting casually in the driver's seat of an open-frame vehicle (like a Jeep or buggy). He wears a graphic t-shirt and jeans, resting his arm on his knee. The background features soft-focus blue and green tones, while the foreground is anchored by a prominent typographic logo in the top left corner consisting of large Roman numerals behind a sans-serif name.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally but leaning into the frame
Typography anchored in the upper-left negative space
Vehicle roll bars framing the subject's head and shoulders
Color harmony between the blue jeans and the teal/blue background
coreInvariants: Layered depth between text, subject, and vehicle frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-close-up, occupying the center and right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast black Roman numerals in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the typographic logo, move down the subject's arm, and rest on the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Upper left corner is kept clear of complex background details to accommodate text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blues and teals in the background and denim.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and earthy browns in the vehicle interior.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Solid black for the primary typographic element.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Mid-range saturation with a soft, slightly matte finish in the shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly vibrant primary colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of high-contrast Didone serifs and condensed geometric sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Roman numerals use thick vertical strokes and thin horizontal serifs
Name text uses uniform stroke weight with rounded terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Roman numerals are scaled significantly larger to act as a background element for the name

composition.relationshipToImage: high contrast against black background text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Superimposing a light, condensed sans-serif over a dark, heavy serif for depth.

preserve: The contrast between the Roman numerals and the name text
avoid: Distressed or weathered textures on the text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the high-contrast serif look for the Roman numerals.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Trade Gothic Condensed or Alternate Gothic
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, condensed sans-serif style for the name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man with dark hair in his 30s, wearing a dark graphic t-shirt and blue jeans, sitting relaxed in an open-frame off-road vehicle. The background should be a soft-focus teal and blue wall. Natural daylighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large black Roman numerals 'III' in the top left corner. Overlap these numerals with the artist's name in a white, condensed sans-serif font, centered horizontally relative to the numerals.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the top left corner?
Is the name white and the numerals black?
Is the subject wearing a graphic tee and jeans?
Is the vehicle frame visible around the subject?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the background teal color
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the vehicle or clothing

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text
avoid: Cluttered backgrounds that interfere with the text

postGenerationChecks: Text is legible and correctly layered
Subject's pose feels natural and relaxed
Composition follows the rule of thirds for the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Medium-shot male portrait + open-frame vehicle + top-left layered serif/sans-serif typography.
